metadata.description: Ten MIT GTM operator skill packs: PSP, EVP, cold email, founder-brand, pricing, landing page, GEO, sales offer, prospect list, email sequence. Plus build-pack, the gate for the next pack.

plugins.name: psp
plugins.description: A Pain Signal Profile is a five-part buying brief. It replaces a static ICP.

plugins.name: evp
plugins.description: An Early Value Proposition is a ≤22-word line matched to a Schwartz awareness tier.

plugins.name: cold-email
plugins.description: Four jobs in under 90 words: signal, pain, EVP, binary ask. Demographics are not a signal.

plugins.name: founder-brand
plugins.description: Pillar / Proof / Process / Person. Refuses thought-leader cadence.

plugins.name: pricing
plugins.description: Pricing surgery: WTP, value metric, reference frame, three-tier contrast, pocket-price leaks.

plugins.name: landing-page
plugins.description: One page, one offer, one action. Drafts the page and scores it; refuses a sitemap.

plugins.name: geo
plugins.description: Generative engine optimization: score whether a page gets quoted by an answer engine. Refuses a content calendar.

plugins.name: sales-offer
plugins.description: What the buyer gets, what it costs, and why now. Refuses a pitch of the paid product.

plugins.name: prospect-list
plugins.description: Score who to contact this week from one public buying signal. Refuses a title-only list.

plugins.name: email-sequence
plugins.description: The series of emails after someone raises their hand. Refuses a generic drip.

plugins.name: build-pack
plugins.description: The gate for the next GTM skill pack: knowledge card, design card, security, README, and plugin checks. For pack authors, not a customer pack.
